events.name: Monster Jam Freestyle Mania presented by Spin Master
events.info: Get ready for the event that will change everything you thought you knew about freestyle-Monster Jam Freestyle Mania, presented by Spin Master. Monster Jam trucks team up with Freestyle Motocross bikes to deliver gravity-defying skills and thrills. We've created one-of-a-kind FMX bikes for this epic team competition, each with the bold, iconic look of your favorite Monster Jam trucks, like the legendary Grave Digger, El Toro Loco, Sparkle Smash and more. Cheer for your favorite team as they pull off stunts you've never seen before. The energy, the action, the next-level thrills will keep you on the edge of your seat. It's a high-energy good time and it's only at Monster Jam. For group tickets contact FARGODOME Ticket Office group sales.
events.pleaseNote: - All guests ages 2 & older are required to have a ticket. - No costumes for guests 14 & older. - Please monitor the venue website for venue policies, including health and safety protocols, which are subject to change. - All tickets are subject to availability. - Prices & Competitors are subject to change. - Monster Jam Trackside begins approximately one hour before the event start time and features: *Competition Preview *Driver Interviews *Behind the Scenes with the Pit Crew *Judges Zone Overview *Opening Ceremonies *Giveaways *Power Rush Track Introductions. There's no better way to get ready for the action, so get to your seats early to experience all the family fun. -Visit MonsterJam.com for more event info and Ticket Terms and Conditions. For group tickets contact FARGODOME Ticket Office group sales. Section 5 is a Family No Alcohol section.
